Q6097.reason: Modern law construes 'heirs of his body' as creating a fee simple, so the cousin took a fee simple and the niece's later conveyance passed a fee simple.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on facts reasonably relied upon by experts in the field, and the doctor's x-ray interpretation followed accepted medical practice.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into the guest's hotel room at night with intent to commit a felony (threat/extortion) inside constitutes common-law burglary.
